raw.query: WITH selected AS (SELECT CASE d.run_id WHEN 'live:twin_fc_p90' THEN 'live' ELSE 'offline' END AS mode, d.run_id, d.window_name, i.achieved_p99_ms, i.n_requests_raw, i.n_requests AS n_requests_effective, d.is_current, (d.superseded_by IS NOT NULL) AS is_superseded FROM provenance.v_dim d JOIN provenance.v_infraction i USING (run_id) WHERE d.run_id IN ('live:twin_fc_p90','planner:week_fc_p90') AND d.is_current = true AND i.is_current = true AND i.sla_metric = 'ttft'), pivoted AS (SELECT MAX(achieved_p99_ms) FILTER (WHERE mode = 'live') AS live_p99_ms, MAX(achieved_p99_ms) FILTER (WHERE mode = 'offline') AS offline_p99_ms, MAX(n_requests_raw) FILTER (WHERE mode = 'live') AS live_n_raw, MAX(n_requests_raw) FILTER (WHERE mode = 'offline') AS offline_n_raw, MAX(n_requests_effective) FILTER (WHERE mode = 'live') AS live_n_effective, MAX(n_requests_effective) FILTER (WHERE mode = 'offline') AS offline_n_effective, BOOL_AND(is_current) AS all_current, BOOL_OR(is_superseded) AS any_superseded, STRING_AGG(mode || ':' || COALESCE(window_name, '<none>') || ':n=' || n_requests_effective, ', ' ORDER BY mode) AS window_breakdown FROM selected) SELECT live_p99_ms, offline_p99_ms, 100.0 * (live_p99_ms / offline_p99_ms - 1.0) AS delta_pct, ROUND(live_p99_ms::numeric) AS live_rounded_ms, ROUND(offline_p99_ms::numeric) AS offline_rounded_ms, ROUND((100.0 * (live_p99_ms / offline_p99_ms - 1.0))::numeric, 1) AS delta_rounded_pct, live_n_raw, offline_n_raw, live_n_effective, offline_n_effective, all_current, any_superseded, window_breakdown FROM pivoted
